description_en: Queries the actual benefits of auto-clustering for a specified table by using paging. Records are aggregated by job signature and include saved CU hours, shuffle data volume, and job duration
description_zh: 分页查询指定表的自动聚簇实际收益。记录按作业签名统计，包含节省的 CU 时、Shuffle 数据量和作业耗时
kebab_example: aliyun maxcompute list-auto-cluster-job-info --project analytics_prod --table order_detail --api-version 2022-01-04 --region cn-hangzhou
name: ListAutoClusterJobInfo

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute project
parameters.name: project

parameters.help_en: The name of the MaxCompute table
parameters.name: table

parameters.help_en:
Specifies the scope of benefit statistics. Valid values:
true: Calculates the cumulative benefits after auto-clustering is applied.
false: Retrieves the daily benefits from the latest batch of data.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 收益统计范围。false 表示取最新一批数据中的当日收益，true 表示累计统计聚簇应用后的收益。默认为 false
parameters.name: since_created

parameters.help_en: The sort field. Valid values: savedTime, savedCu, and savedShuffle. Default value: savedCu
parameters.help_zh: 排序字段。支持 `savedTime`、`savedCu`、`savedShuffle`。默认使用 `savedCu`
parameters.name: sort_field

parameters.help_en:
The sort order. Valid values:
true: Ascending order.
false: Descending order.
Default value: false
parameters.help_zh: 排序方向。true 为升序，false 为降序。默认为 false
parameters.name: order

parameters.help_en: The page number. Pages start from 1. Default value: 1
parameters.help_zh: 页码，从 1 开始。默认值为 1
parameters.name: page_number

parameters.help_en: The number of entries per page. Default value: 10
parameters.name: page_size

parameters.help_en: The name of the schema to which the table belongs
parameters.help_zh: 表所属的 Schema 名称
parameters.name: schema

data.description_en: The results of querying the actual benefits of auto-clustering by job signature
data.description_zh: 按作业签名查询自动聚簇实际收益的结果

autoClusterJobList.description_en: The list of job benefit records on the current page
autoClusterJobList.description_zh: 本页的作业收益记录列表
